# Launch Screen Assets

`LaunchImage` and `LaunchGradient` (with dark variants) are rendered from `SplashArt`
(lib/features/onBoarding/presentation/widgets/splash_art.dart), which follows the Figma
"Splash — Light" / "Splash — Dark" frames, by `flutter test tool/native_splash/render_test.dart`.
Re-run it after changing the design; don't edit these PNGs by hand.
